PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Me.ConfigNote: The pull-out catalogue left of the sheet: what it remembers per viewer, how a card is dragged onto the sheet, the drop marker, its Materials tab (v0.7.0), and its words.
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Me.Source: Written 30-Oct-2026, v0.6.0; the Materials section v0.7.0

PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.Note: Remembered per viewer, as the folds are: whether the drawer is out, and which pictures its cards show.
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.ThumbsNote: RND shows each asset as it is drawn (pen and wash); PXY its proxy, as the SketchUp and three.js apps preview it
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.PaneNote: The tab the drawer opens on: Objects (the asset library) or Materials; the viewer's last choice is remembered

PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Ma.Note: The Materials tab (v0.7.0): the material classes as swatches, given to an object or one face of it by a click on the sheet (the brush), by dragging a swatch onto the sheet, or from the right-click menu.
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Ma.ModeNote: Object gives the class to the whole object (a plop's part, the cottage's walls); Face to the one face clicked, as SketchUp paints. Shift flips it for one click

PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.Note: A card moved this far with the button down is a drag; less is a click, which arms a placement - the next click on the sheet places it (Esc cancels), as an art direction point is placed.
PainterlyNPR__AssetCatalogue__Config__Dr.FootprintMinMNote: The marker's smallest radius on the ground, so a lavender's still shows where it lands
